objective: At least 25% higher verified autonomous utility/hour with preserved demonstrated general capability

capability_evaluation.after_held_out_failure: Preserve failure; any tuned successor requires a fresh frozen held-out panel, with the prior panel retained as regression evidence
capability_evaluation.limitations: Finite local task evidence does not prove universal non-regression

invariants.host: 16GB M1 Mac mini with internal SSD
invariants.comparison_claim_scope: Complete model/runtime/harness configuration; never model-only attribution

supersedes_only: Bundled matched sampling/context requirement, if this proposal is selected before any promotion campaign

native_comparison_contract.control: Exact frozen P1 artifacts/settings/protocol normalization; current OS recorded in both arms
native_comparison_contract.candidate: User-prescribed Bonsai native thinking sampling and medium effort,16K/8192/full local vision for current candidate; any successor frozen anew before campaign
native_comparison_contract.reason: Frozen P1 and prescribed native Bonsai have incompatible sampling/reasoning/output profiles; matching them would change P1 or native Bonsai settings
native_comparison_contract.task_deadlines: Original900s, expanded1800s from frozen task manifests, identical between arms; no inferred timeout waiver
native_comparison_contract.charges: All integrity/preflight/model verification/startup/tools/generation/failures/timeouts/cleanup/verifier work charged; no callback/component timings used for endpoint promotion
native_comparison_contract.heldout: All16 fixed sealed tasks remain withheld from tuning; any failure follows existing fresh-panel rule
native_comparison_contract.hard_gates: Every original promotion/capability/resource/protocol/permission gate retained; invalid protocol/host runs cannot promote
native_comparison_contract.required_disclosure: Every permitted profile difference, source/model/runtime/harness/prompt/skill/config/hash, hardware/OS/storage/cache/thermal policy in frozen plan and per-run receipts
native_comparison_contract.activation: Draft only; does not authorize any promotion or change running/frozen experiments
